handoff_rule: PRD-11.2R is not authorised until PRD-11.1R evidence records a valid taxonomy, governance sync/freshness check, and behavioural-gate contract.
release_gate_rule: Product, runtime, governance, and advisory classes must be explicitly separated. Product/runtime/security-contract evidence is blocking for release; governance/evidence is supporting unless it consumes independent runtime proof.

test_classes.description: Real application behaviour: services, routes, DB-backed domain flows, auth, POPIA, billing, learner journeys.
test_classes.label: Product tests
minimum_evidence: DB-backed journey or explicit skip justification

test_classes.description: Stack health: Postgres, Redis, migrations, schema, /ready, worker, frontend proxy.
test_classes.label: Runtime tests

test_classes.description: PRD records, registers, evidence files, authority transitions, documentation sync/freshness.
test_classes.label: Governance/evidence tests
minimum_evidence: production register next item agrees with PRD register
closed PRD verifiers tolerate later register progression

test_classes.description: Ruff, mypy, Bandit, coverage, dependency audit, route inventory, OpenAPI drift.
test_classes.label: Advisory/static tests
minimum_evidence: dependency audit result or accepted risk ledger
